vulnerabilityTitle: Unhandled Execution Fault in Auth Vault
summary: Implemented constant-time bitwise XOR token comparison, 12-char minimum length, and strict role allowlisting. (0-token local synthesis)
rootCause: Session verifier relied on short-circuit equality and permitted unvalidated role elevation.
